# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Capability type: tau2 airline agent. Editable surfaces: `policy/policy.md` (system-prompt) and `tools/tools.py` (tools). Seed baseline val reward 0.317 (0 solid / 7 flaky / 3 failing of 10). Scoring averages a DB component (final DB state matches gold writes) and a COMMUNICATE component (required values stated to the user). Action-trace detail is diagnostic only.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials × recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong-reservation targeting | 17, 22 (6 trials, hard-0) | User describes a trip with no reservation id; agent grabs the FIRST id from `get_user_details` and operates on the wrong booking, so every downstream write is wrong. No tool existed to list/match a user's reservations by route. | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW read tool `find_reservations` + policy resolution rule |
| 2 | Guessed/stale payment total on booking | 25, 23 (6 trials) | Agent builds the payment split from prices stored on an existing reservation (stale) instead of current prices → `book_reservation` raises "does not add up" and writes nothing; opaque error strands it. | CAPABILITY-GAP + recoverable-error | NEW read tool `get_price_quote` + enriched `book_reservation` error |
| 3 | Mental fare/refund math → wrong COMMUNICATE and wrong follow-up write | 11 (and cabin-change family 37) | Agent computes charge/refund by hand, states the wrong number (fails COMMUNICATE in 11), and sometimes swaps a segment off the bad number. The engine already computes the exact delta but discarded it. | KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL | Return `payment_delta`/`amount_charged`/`amount_refunded` from update tools + policy "quote the returned number" |
| 4 | Unauthorized extra write (cancel of a flown reservation) | 37-t2 | Agent cancelled a reservation whose segments had already flown (policy forbids; API does not enforce), corrupting the DB. | BEHAVIORAL (act-vs-refuse) | In-body eligibility guard in `cancel_reservation` |
| 5 | Narrate-without-action / bail-out after confirm | 12, 37-t1, 23-t2, 25-t2 | After the user confirms, agent reports the change as done or transfers without issuing the write; after a write error it abandons instead of retrying. | BEHAVIORAL | Policy "execute immediately after confirmation" + "recover from a write error" contract (prose; no clean code lever since the stall is skipping the call entirely) |

Task 40 skipped — documented infra noise (tau2 user-simulator leak). Task 8's flakiness partly shares cluster 1 (resolve a referenced prior flight) — `find_reservations(flight_number=/route=)` covers it.

## Changes made this iteration (multiple classes)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `add` read tool | tools.py `find_reservations` | Lists every reservation of a user with route/date/passenger summary; optional origin/destination/flight_number/date filters match on trip OR any segment. General resolver for "which reservation does the user mean" — no task literals. | Additive new tool; cannot change any existing call. |
| 1 | prompt rule + worked example | policy.md "Identify the correct reservation first" | Imperative: when no id given, call `find_reservations` with the mentioned filters, confirm the id, never assume the first. | Reinforces existing "locate it using available tools"; doesn't flip any decision. |
| 2 | `add` read tool | tools.py `get_price_quote` | Computes the authoritative booking total from CURRENT prices (reuses book_reservation's exact pricing: price×pax + 50×bags + 30×pax insurance). Lets the model build a correct split in one shot. | Additive; read-only. |
| 2 | `code` enriched error | tools.py `book_reservation` | "does not add up" now names total, component breakdown (flights/baggage/insurance), the sum paid, and the signed shortfall + "resubmit summing to EXACTLY N; don't use stored prices". Also payment-not-found now lists available ids. Turns a terminal error into a one-retry fix. | Only changes error text on an already-failing call; passing calls never hit it. |
| 3 | `code` enriched return | tools.py `update_reservation_flights`, `update_reservation_baggages` | Return now includes `payment_delta`/`amount_charged`/`amount_refunded` alongside the full reservation dump. Gives the agent the exact number to report (fixes 11's COMMUNICATE "5244"). | DB mutation unchanged (done in place before return); grader reads DB + call args, so DB-only passing tasks are unaffected; adds info the COMMUNICATE check wants. |
| 3 | prompt rule | policy.md "Change cabin" | "Don't compute the charge/refund by hand; quote the returned payment_delta verbatim." | Additive guidance. |
| 4 | `code` in-body guard | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | Refuses cancel if any segment already flown (instance status flying/landed, or date < today) or already cancelled; actionable error pointing to transfer_to_human. Enforces policy line 141 the API skips. | Verified it does NOT fire on the legitimately-cancelled reservations in passing trials 19-t1 (future 05-28) and 23-t1 (future 05-26/28); fires on 37-t2's NQNU5R (05-13/14, flown). |
| 5 | prompt contract + examples | policy.md intro | "Execute immediately after confirmation" (next action MUST be the write; don't say 'done' before the tool returns) and "Recover from a write error" (correct args and re-issue; don't abandon/transfer). | Tightens, doesn't loosen; no passing task relied on narrating-without-acting. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the change does on those exact inputs)
- 17/22 (wrong reservation UM3OG5 vs gold FQ8APE): policy now routes to `find_reservations(user_id, origin="JFK"/"LGA"/"EWR", destination="ORD")`, which returns FQ8APE's summary; agent operates on the right id. Verified `find_reservations` filter matches on trip origin/dest OR any segment.
- 25-t2 / 23-t1 ("does not add up", paid 299 vs 375): verified the new error prints `total=375 (flights 375 + baggage 0 + insurance 0); paid 299 short by 76 — resubmit summing to 375`; `get_price_quote` returns `{total:375,...}` so the split is right on the first call.
- 11-t0 (DB right, told user refund $5,548; gold COMMUNICATE value 5244): `update_reservation_flights` now returns `amount_refunded` = the engine's exact figure; policy tells the agent to quote it. Verified the return dict is built from the same `total_price` the engine already computed.
- 37-t2 (bad cancel of flown NQNU5R): verified guard blocks it (date 2024-05-13 < today 2024-05-15) while allowing Z7GOZK (19-t1) and K1NW8N (23-t1).

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 3 parallel read-only `general-purpose` diagnostic agents, one per trajectory cluster (update_flights 17/22/37/11; book 23/25; get_reservation+calculate 8/12/22). Merged their findings into this one candidate. Serial implementation after merge.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (iteration 1, empty LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP, empty rejected.jsonl/history.jsonl).

## Good things to PRESERVE (don't let a future iteration undo these)
- The cancel flown-guard is verified safe against passing cancels — keep it; don't broaden it to other eligibility conditions without re-checking 19/23.
- `find_reservations` and `get_price_quote` are additive read tools; the toolset is at 16 (< 20). Don't remove the raw write primitives — they are still the only write path and the fixes are guards/returns, not wrappers.
- The update tools return a dict superset of the reservation (full `model_dump()` + delta fields); keep the full dump so nothing the agent/grader needs is lost.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 40: documented infra noise (user-simulator ###STOP### leak) — instructed not to optimize against it.
- Baggage-allowance auto-computation in book_reservation (membership × cabin): a latent risk, but NO failing trial in these traces miscomputed bags (all were 0/0), so a guard there is speculative — skipped to avoid an edit no trace supports.
- A composite confirm→write tool for the narrate-without-action stall: considered, but the stall here is the agent ending the turn / transferring, which a composite can't force; the prose contract is the available lever this iteration. If cluster 5 persists next iteration, switch to a composite WRITE tool.
